sources.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash API, Pricing & Playground | Vercel AI Gateway
sources.snippet: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is MiniMax's M-series language model for agent reasoning, tool use, coding, and long-context tasks, with a 1,000,000-token context window. Compared with MiniMax-M3, it adds always-on reasoning and adjustable reasoning effort, allowing developers to tune reasoning effort for different tasks.

sources.title: minimax-m3.1-flash
sources.snippet: As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.
